title: Remaining AutoFirma gaps and two review findings
result: the TSA lookup refuses internal resolved addresses (0782998); the TSA request has a 30 s total deadline and IPv6 is limited to global unicast (83feb05); PDF document timestamps, `--sello` and `tsType` 2/3 (bd27257); every ds:Signature is left out of an enveloped digest, which broke signing XML that was already signed (69cce79); XAdES cosign and countersign, PAdES cosign through AutoScript (2f4fabe).
evidence: `pnpm check:ci` passes (1701 tests); `localtest.me` refused, drip server cut at 30 s; freetsa document token passes `openssl ts -verify` over the byte range; xmlsec1 verifies all 16 signatures of the cosign and countersign runs, including over AutoFirma's own signatures.
